name: Koto Japanese Steak House
metaTitle: Koto Japanese Steak House: Japanese in Hyde Park
metaDescription: Koto Japanese Steak House at 533 S Howard Ave serves hibachi and sushi. Lunch is 11:30am to 3:00pm on weekdays, and delivery has a $30 minimum.

publish.hoursNote: Lunch and dinner are separate shifts on the Koto site. Weekday afternoons between those shifts are not listed as open.

facts: Koto Japanese Steak House, Hyde Park, Tampa. Database address 533 S Howard Ave #4, Tampa, FL 33606. Website location line: 533 S Howard Ave. Tampa, FL 33606. Phone 813-964-6808 and (813) 964-6808.
The site says Japanese and Asian dishes, hibachi prepared at the table, and sushi. It says Koto has been established for over 10 years.
Lunch hours Monday - Friday 11:30am - 3:00pm. Dinner Monday - Thursday 5:00pm - 10:00pm, Friday 5:00pm - 11:30pm, Saturday 3:00pm - 11:30pm, Sunday 3:00pm - 10:30pm.
Delivery note: $30 minimum order for delivery within 4 miles. Promotions are only for dine in and cannot be combined. Free birthday meal up to $15 discount, must show ID.

Nearby from our coordinates: The Optic Shop 0.01 miles at 533 S Howard Ave #6, slug the-optic-shop. LaFrance Family Law 0.17 miles at 2503 W Swann Ave, slug lafrance-family-law. Sunset & Spice 0.27 miles at 204 S Howard Ave, slug sunset-and-spice. Neighborhood /neighborhoods/hyde-park.

faq.q: Does Koto serve lunch and dinner without a break?
faq.a: On weekdays the site lists lunch until 3:00pm and dinner from 5:00pm. It does not list the hours in between as open.
The site says a $30 minimum for delivery within 4 miles.

faq.q: How does the birthday offer work?
faq.a: The site says a free birthday meal up to a $15 discount, dine-in only, with ID, and it cannot be combined with another special.
